text:
Nina: quick idea 
2-day microtest: post + tiny webinar + $2 trial credit + 2 prompt templates. test if bundle beats post-only for 48h activation.
Priya: love it. keep cohort: new signups 7d US/EU.
Tom: routing: bundle-claimers -> quick-start drip; webinar regs -> nurture. keep them separate for clean signals.
Leo: templates: 'discover chat', 'summary-lite'. credit $2 one-per-user, expires in 7 days.
Nina: copy variant A: 'Try Redwood: 2 templates + $2 to start'. Variant B: 'Join a 20min demo + get hands-on templates'.
Tom: ops-bot can you expose flag and webhook fields for experiment_id, bundle_claimed, webinar_registered?
ops-bot: created flag: micro_launch_bundle_01. webhook will include: "experiment":"micro_launch_bundle_01","bundle_claimed":false,"webinar_registered":false. cohort set to new_signups_7d_us_eu.
Priya: metrics: primary = % who generate a successful response within 48h. secondary = webinar attendance, claim rate, 7d retention.
Nina: timeline: assets by Wed, flag on Thu, run 14 days, quick sync after 7 days. owners: Nina (owner), Leo (templates), Tom (infra), Priya (copy + metrics).
Tom: will add a daily BigQuery view for experiment dims. ETA 48h.
Nina: sweet. launching tight and measuring fast. :rocket:
